user.title: Connect your mailbox
user.description:
Parcelmon reads carrier notification emails from a single Gmail label.

Before continuing:
1. Create a Gmail filter for `from:(auspost.com.au OR teamglobalexp.com)` that applies a label.
2. Create an App Password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (requires 2-Step Verification).

Only the label below is ever opened. Your inbox is never read.

data_description.password: 16-character Google App Password, not your account password. Spaces are removed automatically.
data_description.folder: The Gmail label your filter applies. Nested labels use Parent/Child.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your App Password
reauth_confirm.description: The mailbox rejected the stored credentials for {username}. Google revokes App Passwords when the account password changes, so a new one is needed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the mail server. Check the host, port, and your network.
error.invalid_auth: The mail server rejected these credentials. Use a 16-character App Password, and confirm IMAP is enabled in Gmail settings.
error.unknown_folder: That label was not found. Available: {folders}
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This mailbox and label are already set up.

data.mark_seen: Mark emails as read once processed
data.push: Update as soon as email arrives

data_description.retire_days: Set to 0 to keep delivered parcels indefinitely.
data_description.mark_seen: Turn off to leave mail unread. Parcels are still de-duplicated by Message-ID.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to check the mailbox. Minimum 10 minutes. Ignored while 'Update as soon as email arrives' is on, which falls back to an hourly safety check.
data_description.push: Keeps a connection open to the mail server (IMAP IDLE) so carrier email is picked up within seconds instead of on the timer. Falls back to timed checking if your server does not support it.

rescan.name: Rescan mailbox
rescan.description: Looks for parcels in email that is already in the folder, including mail that has been read. Normal checking only looks at unread mail, so this is how you pick up parcels from before Parcelmon was installed. The folder is opened read-only, so nothing is marked read and it is safe to run repeatedly.

config_entry_id.name: Mailbox
config_entry_id.description: Which configured mailbox to scan. Leave empty to scan all of them.

days.name: Look back
days.description: How many days of email to examine. Set to 0 to scan the entire folder.

limit.name: Message limit
limit.description: Stop after this many of the most recent messages. Keeps a large folder from taking a long time.

add_parcel.name: Add parcel
add_parcel.description: Track a parcel by hand. Use this when the carrier email never arrives, or arrives in a format Parcelmon cannot read. If a real email for the same tracking number turns up later it takes over, so you will not end up with a duplicate.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The consignment number printed on the carrier's notification.

status.name: Status
status.description: Where the parcel is now. Leave as Unknown if you are not sure.

sender.name: Sender
sender.description: Who sent it. Shown in the device name and available to notifications.

eta.name: Expected delivery
eta.description: Free text, shown as-is. For example 'Thursday 30 Jul'.

config_entry_id.name: Mailbox
config_entry_id.description: Which configured mailbox to add it to. Leave empty to use the only one.

remove_parcel.name: Remove parcel
remove_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel and delete its entities. Accepts either the tracking number or the internal uid. A later email for the same parcel will start tracking it again.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number, or the parcel's uid such as auspost_36ypj5053229.

config_entry_id.name: Mailbox
config_entry_id.description: Which configured mailbox to remove it from. Leave empty to search all of them.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Parcelmon mailbox {target} is not loaded. Enable it and try again.

no_entries.message: No Parcelmon mailbox is set up yet.
